items.exampleEn: In the story, the boy suffers years of deprivation before he finds a home.
items.exampleZh: 在故事裡，那個男孩經歷了多年的匱乏，才終於找到一個家。

items.exampleEn: Palm trees are known for their resilience in strong winds.
items.exampleZh: 棕櫚樹以在強風中的韌性聞名。

items.exampleEn: Lack of money should not be an impediment to education.
items.exampleZh: 缺錢不應該成為受教育的阻礙。

items.exampleEn: This plant is resilient and survives dry summers.
items.exampleZh: 這種植物很有韌性，撐得過乾燥的夏天。
items.glossZh: 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的

items.exampleEn: The decision had a detrimental effect on sales.
items.exampleZh: 這個決定對銷售造成了不利的影響。

items.exampleEn: The fragmentation of the forest into small pieces threatens wildlife.
items.exampleZh: 森林被切割成小塊，威脅到野生動物的生存。

items.exampleEn: Divergent paths in the forest led to two different lakes.
items.exampleZh: 森林裡的分岔小路通往兩座不同的湖。

items.exampleEn: Low pay led to an exodus of nurses from the hospital.
items.exampleZh: 低薪導致大批護理師離開這家醫院。

items.sentenceEn: The language barrier was the biggest impediment to her progress.
items.sentenceZh: 語言隔閡是她進步最大的障礙。

items.audioEn: Every summer there is an exodus of families from the city to the beach.
items.audioZh: 每年夏天，都有大批家庭離開城市到海邊去。
items.questionZh: 每年夏天會發生什麼事？
options: Many families move into the city.

items.sentenceEn: Children are often more resilient than adults think.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們往往比大人以為的更有韌性。

items.sentenceEn: The two scientists have divergent views on the cause of the problem.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩位科學家對問題的成因看法分歧。

items.stemEn: Constant noise can be ____ to your concentration.
items.stemZh: 持續的噪音可能會妨礙你的專注力。

items.stemEn: Living alone on the island for a year tested her ____.
items.stemZh: 在島上獨自住一年，考驗了她的韌性。

items.passageEn: When a huge shopping mall opened outside our town, many people predicted an exodus of customers from the old market. At first, they were right. Several stalls closed, and as regular shoppers went in different directions, the fragmentation of the market community worried everyone. The sellers had divergent opinions about what to do. Some thought the mall was simply too strong; others believed the market had real resilience. In the end, they agreed to open on Sunday evenings with live music. The plan worked, and the market is busier than before. Losing customers was not as detrimental as everyone feared, and even the cynics now admit that the market has a future.
items.passageZh: 城外開了一座大型購物中心時，很多人預料顧客會大批離開舊市場。一開始，他們說對了。好幾個攤位關門，熟客們各奔東西，市場這個小社群的分裂讓大家很擔心。攤販們對該怎麼辦意見分歧。有人認為購物中心實在太強，也有人相信市場確實很有韌性。最後，他們同意在星期天晚上開市，並加上現場音樂。這個計畫奏效了，市場比以前更熱鬧。流失顧客並沒有大家擔心的那麼糟，就連愛唱反調的人現在也承認市場有未來。

questions.questionZh: 購物中心開幕後，一開始發生了什麼事？
options: 攤販們搬進了購物中心

items.promptZh: 長期睡眠不足會影響一個人的判斷力。
referenceEn: Long-term sleep deprivation can affect a person's judgment.
Sleep deprivation over a long time can affect your judgment.
rubricZh: 「睡眠不足」可寫，例如 sleep deprivation、deprivation of sleep 等
「會影響」可寫，例如 can affect、may affect 等
「判斷力」可寫，例如 judgment、ability to judge 等

items.promptZh: 這個小鎮的經濟很有韌性，很快就從困境中恢復了。
referenceEn: The town's economy is resilient and recovered quickly from hard times.
This small town has a resilient economy, and it soon recovered from its difficulties.
rubricZh: 「有韌性」用 resilient（例如 is resilient、a resilient economy 等）
「很快恢復」可寫，例如 recovered quickly、soon recovered 等
「困境」可寫，例如 hard times、difficulties 等
時態配合內容（例如 recovered、has recovered 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：the market suffered from a fragmentation of its community, as regular shoppers went in different directions 用法生硬（fragmentation 少與 a 連用、「熟客各奔東西」與 community 分裂語意牽強）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "as regular shoppers went in different directions, the fragmentation of the market community worried everyone"，中譯同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 inexhaustible、uncharacteristic 為冷僻長字，uncharacteristic 在 u08–u10 多課重複當干擾項
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 改為 divergent、notable，保留 resilient；q14 的 divergent 換成 impediment，兩題不再共用干擾項

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：評分要點只列一種寫法
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為「「睡眠不足」可寫，例如 sleep deprivation、deprivation of sleep 等」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：deprivation 釋義第一義「剝奪」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「匱乏、不足；剝奪」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：「會影響」可寫，例如 can affect、may affect 等／「判斷力」可寫，例如 judgment、ability to judge 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：resilient 表示「有韌性的、能很快恢復的」（例如 more resilient、the most resilient person 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（resilient）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u07-l03-q17；目標字沿用 resilient
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這個小鎮的經濟很有韌性，很快就從困境中恢復了。」、hintWords ["resilient"]、referenceEn ["The town's economy is resilient and recovered quickly from hard times.","This small town has a resilient economy, and it soon recovered from its difficulties."]、rubricZh ["「有韌性」用 resilient（例如 is resilient、a resilient economy 等）","「很快恢復」可寫，例如 recovered quickly、soon recovered 等","「困境」可寫，例如 hard times、difficulties 等","時態配合內容（例如 recovered、has recovered 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 resilient 造一個句子，描述一個很有韌性的人（可以是你自己）。」、referenceEn ["I have become more resilient since I started living alone.","My grandmother is the most resilient person I know."]）
